profile.description: Runs a goshala sheltering more than 120 abandoned, injured, and non-milking cows and bulls in Gopalnagar
profile.mission: The mission of a Vrindavana Goshala trust, which is a shelter for cows in Hindu culture, is to provide a safe and nurturing environment for cows that are no longer able to produce milk or work, as well as those that have been abandoned or are at risk of being slaughtered.

Geographies Served Programs Protection of Cows Programme District Bangalore Rural State Karnataka District Bangalore Rural States Karnataka The Sri Vrindavana Goshala organization provides a sanctuary for over 120 rescued cows, bulls, and calves. They established the goshala at Gopalnagar Near Ramohalli and, despite being newcomers to goseva, they successfully cared for the cows by transforming a barren half-acre land into fertile ground. Through the use of Jeeva Mrutha made from cow dung and urine, they managed to grow green grass, which greatly alleviated the challenges they faced during hot summers and reduced the cost of feed. Eco Friendly Products District Bangalore Rural State Karnataka District Bangalore Rural States Karnataka The organisation offers eco-friendly products like Go-Swach Herbal wash, removing 99.9% of germs and chemicals from produce, and Jeev Amrit Alkaline Drops, enriching water with 21 minerals and vitamins for improved immunity and detoxification. Rooted in Ayurvedic wisdom, these natural and safe solutions provide holistic protection for overall health.
